department: School of Biomedical Engineering, Science & Health Systems

deadline.value: The school admits rolling by term; no PhD deadline date is stated.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The page does not state a supervisor agreement before admission.

funding.value: Financial support is for students with outstanding records, as graduate assistants or Calhoun Fellows; it is not promised.
funding.quote: Students with outstanding academic records may qualify for financial support, either as graduate assistants or as Calhoun Fellows

entry_route.value: Post-baccalaureate and post-master's PhD routes are both offered.
entry_route.quote: Students who have completed only a Bachelor's degree are admitted as Post Baccalaureate

also.quote: students who have earned a prior MS degree may be admitted as Post Master's PhD students

gre_general.value: The school says no GRE is needed for PhD applicants.

english_waiver.value: Applicants with a degree from outside the US must submit TOEFL; an Indian degree does not waive it.
english_waiver.quote: TOEFL scores are required for all international applicants or applicants who earned a degree outside the US

toefl_min.value: TOEFL is required, but no minimum score is stated on the school pages checked.

ielts_min.value: The school's page names only TOEFL, and no IELTS minimum is stated.

notes: School override: fee and English rules come from the BMES how-to-apply page; the school's own application fee is not stated. The school's catalog (catalog.drexel.edu, not fetched) says TOEFL 260; that is not used because it was not fetched from the official program page.
